title: Phase 12A deterministic structured and exact-span evidence verification

nodes.label: External consumer / proposal only
nodes.locator: external consumer; outside MAX Grounding source

edges.action: submit bounded claim proposals and opaque refs returned by fetch_evidence
construct assertions from resolved server-owned fetched text
classify claims from the server-built evidence graph
emit a canonical packet with server-owned identifiers and citations
structured fields require a deterministic labeled relationship; generic claims require a strictly normalized exact source span
return only server-owned source URLs and excerpts; unsupported, partial, and conflicted claims stay blocked

authority_invariants: The external model proposes claim values and never owns evidence, source, citation, or support status.
Structured field support is based on deterministic source structure and field semantics; nearby words alone do not establish a relationship.
Generic exact-evidence support requires a strictly normalized exact source span and returns the server-owned excerpt containing that span.
Search snippets are discovery evidence and cannot enter synthesis without a server-owned fetch reference.
Opaque evidence references are issued by this MAX Grounding instance and caller-provided URLs are not evidence references.
Claim identifiers are generated by the server and are not factual authority.
Only fully supported, non-conflicted claims enter synthesis.
